subject.title: fix(memory): hide QMD transport metadata from recalled content

question: Should the adapter-only fix land now while cleanup of already-persisted contaminated recalls remains tracked separately?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but accepting an adapter-only upgrade boundary versus requiring historical state cleanup is a maintainer-owned merge decision.

options.title: Land adapter fix now
options.body: Refresh the branch, classify the test-type failure, merge the forward fix, and retain historical cleanup in the canonical issue.

options.title: Require migration first
options.body: Hold the PR until it also provides a narrowly tested doctor or migration path for existing contaminated recalls.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Defer the parser if maintainers do not want to change the QMD snippet output contract at this time.

recommendation.title: Land adapter fix now
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, classify the test-type failure, merge the forward fix, and retain historical cleanup in the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QMD manager and memory-core history makes this the strongest available owner for the output-contract and upgrade-scope decision.
